items.title: Dell Sinks 16% in a Week on Intel’s PC Warning. Its CFO Already Saw “Minus Double Digit”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell Technologies (DELL) stock fell approximately 16% from October 26 to November 2, closing near $393 as higher memory costs and weakening PC demand pressured shares. Intel (INTC) projected PC unit declines of approximately 12% in 2026 and 10% in 2027, raising concerns about a prolonged downturn.

items.title: Intel Stock’s (INTC) Deep Sell-Off Shows Signs of an Overreaction
items.summary: Intel Corporation (INTC) stock’s deep sell-off shows signs of an overreaction, in my view, as the market may be overlooking the progress the chipmaker has made in its recovery. Since its June peak, the company’s market capitalization has fallen by more than half. In late October, shares cratered nearly 30% in a single session after the company issued disappointing fourth-quarter guidance. The fear now is that its recovery could take much longer than expected.
